title: The $200 Million Elevator
why_movie: A real first-person Kevin story with a place, people and a turn: a cocktail party at the Prime Minister's house, a hotel elevator two days later, and a remembered name that led to a $200 million deal.
end_words: over the next couple of years

scenes.on: we're in this big cocktail party
scenes.gen: A grand mansion ballroom at night, well-dressed guests in dark suits and evening gowns mingling near tall windows, a server carrying a tray of drinks, crystal chandeliers glowing overhead
scenes.move: a server weaves through the crowd with a tray of champagne glasses while guests turn and chat in small circles

scenes.on: I come on the elevator and there's Renee
scenes.gen: Inside a polished hotel elevator at night, three businessmen in dark suits standing together as a fourth man in a suit steps in through the sliding doors and reaches to shake hands
scenes.move: the elevator doors slide open, the man steps inside and extends his hand toward the group

scenes.on: That's unbelievable. That's amazing. How did you do
scenes.gen: Close view inside a hotel elevator of an older wealthy businessman in a tailored suit, his eyes wide and mouth open in astonishment as he stares across at another man
scenes.move: the astonished man slowly shakes his head in disbelief, his eyebrows raised

scenes.on: resulted in over $200 million in business
scenes.gen: An elegant dinner table set for two in a grand dining room at night, tall windows behind them overlooking a harbor filled with glowing yacht lights, candles and fine china on the tablecloth
scenes.move: a hand lifts a wine glass to toast across the table as the harbor lights glimmer through the window behind them

payoff: that business deal resulted in over $200 million in business over the next couple of years
caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says he met a wealthy businessman's circle once, briefly, at a cocktail party at the Prime Minister's house in Australia.

Two days later, in a hotel elevator, he remembered one of their names instantly.

The man was stunned: "How did you do that?"

That single memory led to a dinner invitation, a business deal, and over $200 million in revenue.

{episode}

The 14 audios are Kevin teaching how to use your mind to get what you want in life. They were recorded live at a private event in the Alps.

Most people will watch this and scroll on. A few will comment "WISH" and start listening tonight.
